about: Freeride lines layer in Skiing (freeride.js). The lines themselves come from OpenStreetMap (the ski routes winter.js already loads: home region, data/ski-canada/ and ca/w/), drawn by skiers who know them, so nothing here is guessed. A route counts as a freeride line when it's a named downhill descent (not an area, a skin track, a road or a park) and OpenStreetMap rates it freeride or extreme, or expert and ungroomed (or with a chute, couloir, face, bowl, glade, ridge, cliff... in its name). Hand-kept below: resorts where every ungroomed expert run is a freeride line (allExpert), names fixed, and lines left out (skip: slackcountry lines, which have their own layer).
